name: Inverted pyramid
summary: Levels that narrow to a point, with the widest first.
description: Show 1 to 8 levels narrowing from the broad top (the many, the starting pool) to the tip below (the selected few, the result). Write one short list entry per level in top-to-bottom order. Export uses editable native shapes; live Inverted Pyramid SmartArt is not yet qualified.
